name: The Alliance Needs More Thorium Bars!
label: Quest
description: The Alliance Needs More Thorium Bars!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It is so good to see you again friend. I hope that you've been doing well. It's true that we are still in need of thorium bars. If you have them to spare I am collecting them for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort.

clips.title: Progress
paras: It is so good to see you again, friend. I hope that you've been doing well. It's true that we are still in need of thorium bars. If you have them to spare I am collecting them for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent, adventurer! A job well done. I'll see to it that those bars get onto the pallet and into the hands of the blacksmiths and engineers that are hard at work building up the supplies for our army. Thank you again, and if you come across more thorium bars be sure to drop by.
